Hacker News Headline Viewer
Description
itis equally mportant to give your flow a description that an LLM can easly understand. Be sure
toinclude the purpose of the flow, the context it willbe used In, and any otherrelevant
information.
This tool can be used to visit hacker news webpage and extract ALL headlines
andlinks from the page that have to do with a particular topic.
Available options for ‘page’:
(empty) - front page
“newest” - newest posts page
Examples of howto use this flow:
"Find Al-related posts on HackerNews"
"Show me political discussions from the newest HackerNews posts
The flow will return relevant articles as clickable markdown links.
